## Description

Cashless pre-auth form (patient, insurer/TPA, policy, scheme, provisional diagnosis ICD-10, proposed treatment, estimate, treating doctor) with required-documents checklist (signed note, labs, masked ID, policy card); record approval reference from TPA email/portal; claims with status; rejected/query items with reason and fix → resubmission; remittance advice matching to invoices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Pre-auth cannot be submitted without required documents attached.
- [ ] **AC2.** Claims list shows actions needed (rejected with reason, query) and resubmission history.
- [ ] **AC3.** Remittance matching reconciles amounts to invoices and flags short payments.
- [ ] **AC4.** Only signed clinical documents can be attached.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
